presets.name: Synth chord stabs
presets.desc: Every string of a chord becomes a square wave through a plucky low-pass sweep; short, polyphonic, instant
presets.notes: Gate with sustain 0 makes each strum a stab; fast strumming stays on the fast bank (tight, a little gritty)

presets.name: Square pad
presets.desc: Held chords turned into soft square waves that swell in slowly and hold their level: a pad behind the band
presets.notes: Clean bank: the cleanest chords, its slow attack hidden by the 600 ms swell

presets.name: Wide saw pad
presets.desc: Chords as detuned saw waves spread left and right, swelling in and held: the classic string-machine pad
presets.notes: Detune 12 cents makes the unison pair; spread places it left and right on a stereo lane

presets.name: Synth brass
presets.desc: Saw waves with a slow filter swell on every pick: a paraphonic synth-brass section from chords
presets.notes: One filter envelope per pick (paraphonic): the 40 ms filter attack is the brass 'blat'

presets.name: Organ chords
presets.desc: Square waves with a sub-octave on the low strings, every partial held at its body level: organ-like chords
presets.notes: Hold 100 % keeps every partial at its body until the noise floor stops it: no decay, no hiss

presets.name: Synth bass from guitar
presets.desc: One saw voice an octave below the note, a plucky filter and a short glide: a synth bass line from a guitar
presets.notes: Mono: exact pitch with the octave guard; play single notes, a chord gives its lowest note

presets.name: Bass square and sub
presets.desc: A bass guitar's notes as a square wave over a sub-octave square, low-passed: a fat synth bass
presets.notes: Lowest 35 Hz opens the detector and the bank floor to a five-string's low B

presets.name: Squelchy lead
presets.desc: A resonant pulse lead whose filter jumps with the pick strength, gliding between notes and bending exactly
presets.notes: Residue 0: only the voice, a classic mono synth (the attack is silent until the note is read, 12 – 29 ms)

presets.name: Stepped robot lead
presets.desc: A thin pulse lead locked to the nearest semitone: bends and vibrato step like a sequencer
presets.notes: Chromatic holds a note with hysteresis: a vibrato across a boundary does not trill

presets.name: Bending chord pad
presets.desc: Detuned saw waves on every string that follow each string's bend: a pad that bends, chords included
presets.notes: Dual sends a bending band back to the fast bank, so the bend is followed within 16 ms

presets.name: 8-bit fuzz synth
presets.desc: Square waves per partial on the fast bank, held flat and wide open: a chiptune fuzz-synth
presets.notes: Fast bank: the tightest attack; chords turn gritty, which is the sound here

presets.name: Guitar plus synth layer
presets.desc: The guitar untouched with a saw synth under it, 6 dB down: a doubled part from one take
presets.notes: The dry is sample-aligned and untouched: the synth sits under the guitar in time

presets.name: Swelled strings
presets.desc: Saw waves that rise slowly under every note and follow the string's level: a bowed, violin-like swell
presets.notes: Attack is the minimum rise in Follow: the pick disappears, the note swells in

presets.name: Expression filter sweep
presets.desc: A resonant synth whose cut-off is swept from the expression pedal, heel dark to toe bright
presets.notes: Put the expression pedal on cutoff; the 7-bit steps are smoothed (golem contract)
